changes.comment: Sheets hydrate prerendered pages unchanged: `iterate()` rows are adopted by their `q-key`, content painted by `template()` / `dangerous-html()` is kept when its source matches, and a `$binding` nobody has written yet keeps the server's paint until hydration ends
A rule no longer rewrites an attribute whose value already reads the same as text (`data-n: 0` over `data-n="0"`)
`Quark.whenSettled({ timeout: Infinity })` waits with no cap (it resolved `"timeout"` at once)
A `@warn` / `@error` whose value is a preserve stays silent and reports on a later run that has a value
